title: Meta’s AI Assistant Muse Surpasses 10 Million Users with Shopping as Leading Activity
description: Meta’s AI personal assistant Muse has attracted over 10 million users, with shopping emerging as a significant activity. CEO Mark Zuckerberg highlights Muse’s growth and its potential impact on commerce through enhanced AI capabilities.

sections.heading: Rapid Adoption of Muse Signals AI’s Growing Role in Everyday Tech
paragraphs: Meta announced during its third-quarter earnings call that its AI app Muse has been adopted by more than 10 million users. This milestone confirms earlier estimates from market intelligence firms and underscores the growing interest in AI-powered personal assistants.
CEO Mark Zuckerberg noted that about 25% of people who set up Muse now use it daily, which helps improve user retention and indicates practical utility across its features.

sections.heading: Shopping Emerges as a Key Use Case for AI Assistance
paragraphs: A notable aspect of Muse’s usage is its role in shopping activities. Zuckerberg shared that over a quarter of Muse’s engaged users who were shopping via the AI agent had an average purchase size of over $200, a figure that surprised industry insiders.
Muse uses Plaid’s connector to enable agentic shopping, facilitating commerce transactions through the AI assistant. This integration highlights the growing intersection of AI and e-commerce.

sections.heading: Privacy and Future Development Plans for Muse
paragraphs: Meta emphasized Muse’s security features, including a component called 'Muse Secure VM' designed to protect user data and privacy. The company also plans to introduce 'Muse Confidential VM,' which will prevent even Meta from accessing users’ content, addressing concerns about AI data protection.

Looking ahead, Meta aims to scale Muse to serve more users while improving compute cost efficiency by more than tenfold within the next year. The company expects Muse to become profitable once revenue scales accordingly.

sections.heading: Muse’s Role in Meta’s Broader Strategy
paragraphs: Muse is expected to play a central role in Meta’s smart glasses strategy, integrating AI capabilities with wearable devices. Reality Labs, the division responsible for smart glasses, VR, and the metaverse, continues to work on reducing its financial losses.

CEO Mark Zuckerberg also mentioned plans for a 'Muse network' that would enable collaboration between users’ AI assistants and those of their friends and family, enhancing social and commerce interactions.
